answer_text: The UMG règlement requires projects to be compatible (compatible, not conforme) with the OAP orientations in pièce n°3. The zone introduction states the orientations (orientations 8 et 9) are those "avec lesquelles tout projet d'aménagement et de construction doit être compatible" (c-01)[zone intro, PDF p.320 / printed p.319]. Article 1 repeats the obligation (c-02)[PDF p.320 / printed p.319], as do Article 10 (c-03)[PDF p.326 / printed p.325] and Article 9 (c-04)[PDF p.326 / printed p.325].
additional_context: The planner rationale describes a 'binding level' without naming the relationship; the règlement sets a compatibility standard, which is lighter than conformité. The OAP document itself was not re-read at this stage, so its content is not verified here. In this corpus the printed page numbers lag the PDF pages by one (PDF 320 = printed 319; PDF 326 = printed 325). Articles 1 to 4, 6 to 13 carry the same clause; Articles 5 and 14 are abrogated and carry none.

This matches the claim: the OAP document n°3, orientations 8 and 9, are the orientations with which any project must be compatible.
